Name: Aquatic Snake
Author: Arcticfez
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds a new "Fish" an aquactic snake to the game. Is a part of the fishing collection and required for 100%,[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Caught in the Ocean, in any season, any weather and any time.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Requires Content Patcher (CP) and Smapi.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]It dosen't work with visable fish, it just won't show in the water.[/color]
Currently prompts error mark when placed in an aquerium. (Patch Coming Maybe),
